response.sql: WITH cnt AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM cnt), sh AS (SELECT cnt.account_id, cnt.c, cnt.c * 1.0 / tot.t AS share FROM cnt, tot), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.c) AS total_orders, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - av.a) AS avg_excess FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.a
